text:
nina_comm: Quick heads-up: we're running an Open Maintainer Sprint next Wed 10am-2pm PT 1:00 UTC for community repos. Goal: triage backlog, land small fixes, and onboard new maintainers. RSVP here: https://forms.gle/example :rocket:

kevin_eng: count eng-platform in. is there a preferred repo list?

nina_comm: yes 1 curated list in the repo under SPRINT_README.md (link in thread). prioritize issues labeled 'good-first-sprint' and 'docs-quick'.

sam_research: I'll prep two eval notebooks and a short checklist for reproducing inference regressions 1 will drop them in the sprint folder.

alexa_evangelism: planning a short intro talk to walk through contribution workflow at 10:05. also will record for folks in other timezones.

community-bot: Reminder: New contributor onboarding badge will auto-assign to anyone who merges their first PR during the sprint.

kevin_eng: small ask: can we add a 'mentor' label so new contributors can request pairing?

nina_comm: good idea 1 adding 'mentor-needed' label now and a short doc entry on pairing expectations.

release-bot: FYI: We'll pin a temporary CODEOWNERS waiver for sprint hours to allow maintainers to merge small fixes without full review per sprint rules. Waiver expires in 48h after the sprint.

alexa_evangelism: I'll add an announcement post to the community newsletter and schedule the livestream demo.

sam_research: signing up to mentor on evals and flaky-test triage.

kevin_eng: i'll mentor on infra and GitHub Actions fixes.

nina_comm: thanks everyone. if anyone wants to be listed as a sprint maintainer, reply with GitHub handle + short note. see you Wed! :sparkles:
